evidence_rule: Only phase=full may decide Gate B; smoke is feasibility evidence only.
primary_metric: normalized vector-contrast squared error against the method-population reference
normalization: mean per-feature squared magnitude of clean and shifted population explanations plus 1e-12
cluster_unit: seed within dataset; datasets receive equal macro weight

criteria.comparison: paired/independent point ratio below one within dataset-model strata for both explainer families
paired_lime / independent_glime_binomial at the same per-side perturbation budget
paired_lime at S-LIME total-query-matched budget / independent S-LIME natural stopping
paired no-shift FAR no greater than independent FAR in both LIME and KernelSHAP
all locked semantic, marginal-law, exact-reference, coverage, hash, and finite-value checks pass

gate_rule: PASS only if B1--B7 all pass; otherwise KILL/PIVOT and Gate C stays closed.
